description: Source code for the WelcomePage component of a web application, implementing a user onboarding/welcome interface with tour options, user config updates, and navigation logic.

methods.name: setWelcomePageViewed
methods.description: Updates user configuration to mark the welcome page as viewed.

methods.name: goForward
methods.description: Navigates the user to the next page based on URL parameters or current team.

methods.name: skipTour
methods.description: Tracks skip event, updates user config, and navigates forward.

methods.name: startTour
methods.description: Tracks start event, prepares onboarding, and navigates to onboarding board.
